title: Add property visual direction
question: The form is white-on-white today. Which look should we build, staying inside the cream + green system?

options.label: Warm workspace
options.thesis: Cream shell, white only on the active step, stronger green on select and primary actions.
options.viewport: Cream page ground; left step rail on muted cream; center form on white; right preview as a quieter inset panel.
options.risk: If contrast stays timid it still reads flat.

options.label: Ink step rail
options.thesis: Dark green left rail for progress; cream center; white only for the fields you touch.
options.viewport: Near-black green step column with light step labels; main stage stays cream with white field clusters.
options.risk: Can feel heavy on a sunny outdoor phone if the rail is too wide.

options.label: Quiet polish
options.thesis: Keep the white shell; only deepen section cards, selected chips, and the preview stack.
options.viewport: Same three columns as today; sections sit on muted cream; selected options use fuller brand-soft.
options.risk: May still feel plain if the shell stays pure white.
